component.name: Masterpiece
component.summary: Pipe organ sample player for Hauptwerk-format and GrandOrgue sample sets

description.p: Masterpiece plays virtual pipe organs: sample sets recorded pipe by pipe from real instruments. It opens a sample set in its package, draws the organ's console, and plays it from MIDI keyboards and pedalboards.

ul.li: Consoles drawn from the sample set's own artwork, in every layout it ships
Combinations, a sequencer and the player's own panels
Perspectives, sample resolution and streaming chosen per organ, with a memory estimate before a load
MIDI learning for every stop, coupler, piston and expression pedal
